product.name: The Social-Commerce Support Agent
product.targetUser: A Pakistani social seller running a fashion or jewellery shop on Instagram or WhatsApp, managing every customer DM alone, with little to no team and no automation.
product.coreProblem: Repetitive DM questions (price, delivery, availability, return policy) eat 30 minutes to 2 hours a day, messages go unanswered after hours, and sellers waste time chasing COD orders that get ghosted on delivery day.
product.wedge: An Instagram/WhatsApp DM AI tool that answers the five most common customer questions (price, delivery, availability, returns, hours) using the seller's own catalogue and policies, and auto-sends a COD confirmation message when an order is placed.

interviews.lostSaleDetail: Lost 2 customers after missing an Instagram DM notification.
interviews.quote: Price DMs sometimes crowd out DMs from customers actually ready to order.
interviews.takeaway: Clearest signal in the batch — a validated missed-notification lost sale, plus explicit testing interest.

interviews.quote: A bot can't negotiate a one-off custom order the way a human can.
interviews.takeaway: Clearest counter-signal — custom/bespoke sellers are a weaker fit for the full five-question assistant.

interviews.lostSaleDetail: Zero lost sales in 4 years, 50+ parcels dispatched.
interviews.firstAutomationChoice: FAQs, product details, availability, closed-hours messaging
interviews.takeaway: Strongest positive data point — fast reply time correlates with zero lost sales.

interviews.quote: Managing a large audience really needs multiple people, not just better manual tools.
interviews.takeaway: Independently confirms availability/product-lookup as the top automation priority; surfaces a headcount-scaling insight.
